about_the_game:
The year is 930. Uline is in the aftermath of a biological weapon known as Strife, which has mutated the flora and fauna of the island into twisted shadows of their previous forms. Uline is in quarantine, kept away from the rest of the world. But you want to change that…

Play as an explorer who wants to escape from Uline. But to do so, you must fight people trying to keep you trapped. Tame Ashen and work together to escape this forsaken island

Core Features:

  • Choose Your Path: See the different environments that have been affected by Strife, and interact with the Ashen that make their homes there. Decide what the best route to take through Uline is, and manage risks to prepare for the endgame

  • Tactical Combat: Fight a variety of Ashen teams with a party that is ever changing. No two runs will be the same

  • Health Preservation: Manage the health of key Ashen to your strategy, because healing is limited. If an Ashen is affected by a condition, it impacts their abilities for the rest of the run

  • Strategic Teambuilding: Every Ashen is unique, even ones of the same species. You have many ways you can add them to your team, from fishing to stealing them from defeated opponents. Consider what you need, and maximize your odds

  • Powerful Combinations: Throughout a run, you will have opportunities to biologically alter Ashen. Mix and match typing, passives, and stats to creature the most powerful Ashen

Will you be able to escape from Uline? Or will you be trapped for the rest of your life?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+, Windows 10, or later (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 (2.0 GHz) or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: In this strategic, turn-based puzzle game, escape an island after a catastrophic event altered the biology around you. Befriend and battle with creatures called Ashen. But be careful. Any injuries Ashen sustain are permanent, and impact them in battle. Can you escape before it's too late?
